list: Official 55 trophies, verified 2026-11-19 against Exophase (descriptions, in order) and planetgta6.com (names and grades, cross-checked with Exophase, PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements). 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden. Counts are the progress targets PlayStation tracks, as listed by PSNProfiles.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
planetgta6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements
Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. There is no shortcut: the platinum is the receipt for the whole list — story, collectibles, activities and robberies included. Use the Roadmap tab to work in the order that wastes the least backtracking.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn; nothing to prepare, just follow the mission as it plays.
trophies.missableNote: Story-gated: the opening mission. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — no mission replay has been reported for GTA VI.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by completing its story missions in order. Story trophies unlock as you play the main missions, so keep pushing the story forward. Before the chapter ends, make a manual save: that save is your way back if you want to replay anything in the chapter.
trophies.missableNote: Story-gated: ends Chapter 1. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — no mission replay has been reported for GTA VI.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no mission replay)

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by completing its story missions in order. The chapter trophies come one per chapter, so this is simply story progress. Save manually at the chapter start so you can return to anything in it later.
trophies.missableNote: Story-gated: ends Chapter 2. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — no mission replay has been reported for GTA VI.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by completing its story missions in order. By this chapter both protagonists are in play, so side content opens up alongside the story — but the trophy itself only needs the chapter finished.
trophies.missableNote: Story-gated: ends Chapter 3. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — no mission replay has been reported for GTA VI.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by completing its story missions in order. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so once it pops, the end of the story is close — make your manual save before the final mission.
trophies.missableNote: Story-gated: ends Chapter 4. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — no mission replay has been reported for GTA VI.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission to earn one of the two gold trophies. Before you start it, make a manual save: it is the end of the story, and the guides reporting on the game say there is no mission replay, so that save is your only way back to anything you left behind in the story.
trophies.missableNote: Story-gated: the finale. Make a manual save BEFORE the final mission — it is the end of the story and no mission replay has been reported.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (no mission replay)

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as you play through the chapters, so you will meet it in story order. If you are following the roadmap, story missions are stage one — just play them as they come.
trophies.missableNote: Story mission. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter it falls in.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is one of the named story missions, so it unlocks in story order as you work through the chapters. No preparation beyond reaching it in the story.
trophies.missableNote: Story mission. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter it falls in.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, it comes from playing the story in order — reach the mission, finish it, and the trophy pops.
trophies.missableNote: Story mission. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter it falls in.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is a story mission like the others in this set: play the chapters in order and it unlocks when you finish the mission.
trophies.missableNote: Story mission. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter it falls in.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It is a story mission, so it unlocks in chapter order. The airport is also the setting of the Catch Me If You Can trophy, so keep VCIA in mind while you are there.
trophies.missableNote: Story mission at the airport. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter it falls in.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named-mission trophies: finish the mission in story order and it pops. After the story missions are done, the roadmap moves on to strangers, collectibles and activities.
trophies.missableNote: Story mission. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter it falls in.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the full checklist the game tracks: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration. It is the long grind behind the platinum and one of only two gold trophies. Work the roadmap's later stages and the completion counter climbs; the last few percent are usually the collectibles and the 50 challenges.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, airtime and the like, as the game counts them. Stunts build up naturally while you drive hard around Leonida; to farm them deliberately, use fast cars and the long straight roads and ramps you already know, and watch the counter climb.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Dip into every activity the map offers — races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, bowling and the rest — one go at each is enough. It pairs naturally with the other activity trophies, so do it while you are sampling them anyway.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. PSN tracks each range's medal, so work range by range and repeat the ones still short of gold. Ranges are repeatable, so take your time: learn each course's targets first, then chase the time and accuracy a gold medal needs.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need a win at all of them, not 14 wins at one place. Drone races are repeatable — practise a course, learn its gates, then win it.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: the same race won twice counts once. Work through the race list across Leonida and tick off a new one each time — road, off-road and any other race type the map offers.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, then out-fish him in that contest — steady reeling beats frantic reeling when the line is tense, and landing the bigger catch wins the challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play one arcade cabinet through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you enjoy most and finish it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. This is the end of a stranger's mission strand: take Andy's missions whenever they appear and follow the strand to its last job. Stranger strands are story-gated, so keep a save before each chapter in case a strand only opens in a certain window.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission of a stranger strand — story-gated. Finish the strand before the story moves past it; keep a chapter-start save.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton — the last job of his stranger strand. Follow Kenton's missions from their first appearance through to the finale, and do not leave his strand half-finished when a chapter ends.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission of a stranger strand — story-gated. Finish the strand before the story moves past it; keep a chapter-start save.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy — the last job of his stranger strand. Take Billy's missions as they appear and see the strand through to its final mission.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission of a stranger strand — story-gated. Finish the strand before the story moves past it; keep a chapter-start save.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Take stranger missions as they appear on the map and finish whole strands, not just the first job — eight finished strands is the target. The five named-character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the eight, so three more strands complete it.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy — the last job of his stranger strand. Follow Randy's missions from their first appearance through to the finale.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission of a stranger strand — story-gated. Finish the strand before the story moves past it; keep a chapter-start save.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone — the last job of his stranger strand. Take Tyrone's missions as they appear and see the strand through to its final mission.
trophies.missableNote: Final mission of a stranger strand — story-gated. Finish the strand before the story moves past it; keep a chapter-start save.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Spots are scattered across the map; visit each and meditate there. PSN tracks how many you have found, so sweep region by region and the counter shows what is left. One spot is reported to sit in Chapter 1, so meditate at every spot you pass while the story is still early.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (Chapter 1 meditation note)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at one particular animal — follow his missions until the hunt opens, then track that animal down. It is a one-off hunt, so save before you start it and do not let the animal get away.
trophies.missableNote: A one-off hunt in a stranger strand. Save before the hunt starts.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Collect as you explore — shops, interiors and the places you pass in missions — and three finished sets is the mark.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo and sharing feature: use it at 100 different spots around Leonida. It counts locations, so spread out — new districts and landmarks each add to the total, and pairing it with exploration finishes two jobs at once.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives and PSN tracks your total, so work through the challenge list steadily alongside everything else — they stack up over a full playthrough, and the last ones are usually the grind behind 100% completion.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Quiet back roads, water and the countryside help you vanish; do not start a new crime while you are hiding.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Line up three shops close together, rob them one after another with your partner, and keep the wanted level alive between them — do not let it clear and do not get busted in between. Plan the route first, then run it fast.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game logs each new vehicle you get into, so drive everything you see — traffic, parked cars, bikes and boats all add to the count. New districts bring new traffic, so this finishes naturally as you explore Leonida.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. A crowded shootout is the place to try it — thin fights with one or two enemies will not give you five targets.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave Vice City International Airport in a way the schedule never planned. Find a runway or a plane and leave on your own terms. It is a one-off moment, so save before you try it.
trophies.missableNote: A one-off moment at the airport. Save before you try it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — deal with the Rhino tanks. The description is deliberately vague; expect a tank encounter in the story or out in the open world, and take the fight to the Rhinos when it comes. Heavy weapons and distance are the sensible approach against armour.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. Plan the approach, move when the shop is quiet, take what you came for and be gone before anyone notices you were there.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate vault jobs, each ending with a clean getaway. Learn one vault's routine, repeat it across five vaults, and do not get caught on the way out — the escape counts as much as the robbery.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, hit it, and get away clean — the escape is part of the trophy, so have your getaway planned before you strike.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas the game tracks. Drive, fly and sail into every corner of the map; the counter ticks up area by area, so a systematic sweep of the regions finishes it. Pair it with WAiNK It and vehicle discovery and one trip covers three trophies.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs illegal operations; hit one operation per gang, nine in total, and the trophy is yours. Keep a note of which gangs you have already hit so the last one is easy to find.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the spot on Ocean Beach with the view, order the cocktail and take it in. It is a quiet one-off moment — do it when you are passing, before the story moves on.
trophies.missableNote: A one-off moment on Ocean Beach. Do it while you are passing; it may not come back later.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a car and drive it straight out through the showroom front — the classic GTA exit. Save first: it is a one-time stunt, not a repeatable activity, so get it right the first time.
trophies.missableNote: A one-time stunt in a showroom. Save before you try it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at that alley and follow through on the shot. Bowling is also one of the activity types, so this doubles as progress toward trying every activity once.
trophies.missableNote: A moment at a named bowling alley. Do it when you first visit the alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is vague on purpose — it points at a partnership moment in the story, most likely a shared success with your partner that draws a crowd. Play the story and it will come; no separate activity is named, so do not go hunting for it in the open world.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. The game tracks the decisions you make — PSN shows a progress count toward 500 — so make decisions as you play, in missions and in the world, and the count climbs. There is nothing to hunt: it rewards playing the game and choosing, not standing still.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail at something, then succeed on the retry — the trophy is for the comeback, not the first try. It will come naturally over a long playthrough; if it has not popped by the endgame, retry any activity you once failed and finish it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida. Explore the odd corners of the map — the strange sights are usually far from the main roads — and witness it for yourself. It is a world event, so keep exploring and it finds you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, swing a melee weapon at someone beside the car and knock them down. Slow down next to a pedestrian, time the swing as you pass, and drive on — speed makes the timing harder, so come in slow.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your contacts to launder them, and the laundered total is what counts. Robberies feed this trophy, so run vaults, trucks and shops and launder everything you take.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and everything else across Leonida's shops; every dollar spent anywhere adds up. It finishes naturally over a full playthrough — garages and vehicles are the big tickets if you are still short.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought around the map — eight in total. Buy them as you can afford them; they also give you somewhere to keep the vehicles you discover, and they count toward the $100,000 of spending as well.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, then register them in the Scooter Bros app — ten registered is the target. Vehicles you discover are the easiest to register, so pair this with Whip It Good and register every new find as you go.
trophies.name: On the Spot
